title: Expensive Napkins from Walmart
text: Expensive Napkins from Walmart. These are very expensive napkins. They’re from Walmart. They probably cost about $2.00 per set and I paid over $15. I was very upset. They should not be described as towels.

product_metadata.title: Custom Bundle Christmas Holiday Red Merry and Green Tis The Season Disposable Guest Towels - 2 Pack - 60 Total
features: GREAT VALUE: 2 packs of 30 paper guest towels - 1 of each design - total 60 2-ply towels
CLASSIC WINTER MESSAGES: Rich red and green colors feature words of the season in white. A classic design that would work well with many decors.
HIGH QUALITY: 2-ply soft and absorbant, these paper towels are a pleasure to use. Your guests will love them!
DIMENSIONS: Guest towels are approximately 16 x 12 inches unfolded and roughly 8 x 4 inches when folded.

PERFECT FOR PARTIES OR EVERYDAY USE: Dress up your solid plates on the buffet table, match with other traditional Christmas plates or use in your guest powder room throughout the season. These towels are versatile and can do it all!
description: Classic messages with a contemporary feel! Traditional red and green colors make these 2 ply guest towels look as good as they feel. Dress up your buffet table or your powder room for the season! 1 pack of each - 60 total paper guest towels.
